use num_bigint::BigInt;
use num_rational::{BigRational,Ratio};
fn fraction(n:i64,d:i64)->BigRational{BigRational::new(BigInt::from(n),BigInt::from(d))}
fn main(){
 let a=fraction(2,3);let b=fraction(5,7);
 assert_eq!(&a+&b,fraction(29,21));assert_eq!(&a-&b,fraction(-1,21));
 assert_eq!(&a*&b,fraction(10,21));assert_eq!(&a/&b,fraction(14,15));
 assert_eq!(a.pow(-2),fraction(9,4));
 assert_eq!(BigRational::from_float(0.125).unwrap(),fraction(1,8));
 assert_eq!(fraction(42,-56),fraction(-3,4));
 assert_eq!(Ratio::<i64>::new(1,3)+Ratio::new(1,6),Ratio::new(1,2));
 let whole:BigInt=(BigInt::from(1u32)<<200usize)+17;
 let large=BigRational::new(whole.clone(),BigInt::from(3));
 assert_eq!((&large*BigInt::from(3)).to_integer(),whole);
 println!("{} {} {}",&a+&b,a.pow(-2),fraction(-3,4));
}
